about: Botanical illustrations for the site (iconography audit 7.6). Generated, reviewed by eye, re-rolled where wrong. Each is an ink mask painted in currentColor, so it follows light/dark/selected states.

items.kind: ink mask (black + alpha); paint with currentColor via CSS mask
items.prompt: A small emblem-like vignette of a smooth pebble balanced on a flat stone with a small fern frond growing beside it. Centred vignette composition: the drawing fades out into white towards the edges and nothing touches or is cut by the image edges.
